law.title: Operating bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter on roadway (3)
law.text: Persons riding bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters upon a roadway shall not ride more than two abreast except on paths or parts of roadways set aside for the exclusive use of bicycles, electric bicycles and electric scooters.
